name: Commerce License Access Control
description: Grant specific content access with Commerce License
project_description:
The Commerce License Access Control module uses ACL and Commerce License to allow sites to sell content with Drupal Commerce.

 A license can grant view, update and/or delete access to a specific node with priorities being handled by ACL.

 Usage 
 
 Select the 'Access Control' license plug-in like you would select any other license plugin. 
 In the entity field select the node that you want to grant access on 
 Select which types of access you want to grant 
 (Optional:) If you use multiple modules that use ACL, give an ACL priority to this grant.
